2026-11-11.title: Juuse Saros' 'busy couple of days' ends in Predators' shutout win vs Kings
2026-11-11.summary: Juuse Saros made 30 saves in a 3-0 shutout win over the Los Angeles Kings, capping a busy few days for the Nashville Predators' goaltender.
